final: WITH elevated AS (SELECT ID, HGB, APTT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9), per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM elevated GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb_across_patients, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt_across_patients FROM per_patient
